chunks: And Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah narrated from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked him about the teeth, so he said: They are equal in the blood money (diyah).
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the value of teeth in Islamic blood money (diyah)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Isfabar, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the diya for all teeth is uniform, reflecting the Shia juristic view that dental injuries are assessed based on the number of teeth rather than their specific function or location. This ruling simplifies the calculation of blood money in cases of assault, emphasizing equality among the thirty-two teeth in the context of compensation.
